title: Altered bills of lading.
bodyText: An unauthorized alteration or filling in of a blank in a bill of lading leaves the bill enforceable according to its original tenor.
bodyHtml: §490:7-306  Altered bills of lading.  An unauthorized alteration or filling in of a blank in a bill of lading leaves the bill enforceable according to its original tenor. [L 2004, c 163, pt of §1]
